sourceLocations.supports: Registered default flexion180 and abduction160 differ; do not compare these endpoints as matched elevation.
Both isolated motions share the setup/approach/hold/return constructor.
Plane-specific setting/ceilings and inverse girdle compensation; pure swing uses minimal arc and preserves the rest direction off its rotation axis.
Upper-arm cosmetic twist is computed from local-rest relative quaternion about localY and distributed0/0.5 across helpers.
The render and sampler share helper deformation; helpers are restored after reading.
Each bone interpolates through its own SQUAD curve; endpoint compensation need not retain the same relation at intervening times.
Existing production sampler builds the same composed poses/trajectory; matched fixtures reuse this pipeline.
Engineering proxy capacity is opt-in through reserved constraints; the two lab default definitions do not opt in.
Existing direct-pose clinical readout and no-apparent-axial-rotation checks pass on current male rig.
Existing real-rig directional invariance checks pass across three bodies/two sides; automatic180 flex exceeds engineering proxy budget.

confirmedObservations: At matched160deg male/right the flexion fixture produces9.2295deg maximum absolute projected axial rotation during the trajectory versus2.5230deg for registered160deg abduction. This remains a numerical route difference, not an anatomical acceptance test.

At matched160deg UpperarmTwist01 local excursion is63.9342deg for flexion versus6.8355deg for abduction; Twist02 is31.9671deg versus3.4175deg. Clinical near-zero direct-pose axial readout does not imply small cosmetic helper deformation.

Registered180deg flexion repeats the retained current observation:12.4736deg transient projected axial rotation and104.4147deg UpperarmTwist01 local excursion. The source deliberately limits its proxy tilt to40deg.

The unregistered180deg abduction fixture shows169.9106deg helper excursion and wrapped projected abduction extrema. It is diagnostic evidence beyond the registered160deg max, not a new accepted movement or proof that current160deg abduction fails.

hypotheses.confidence: probable implementation contribution; skin cause unconfirmed
hypotheses.description: Inverse girdle compensation changes upper-arm local quaternion to preserve world orientation. The cosmetic helper distributor reads that local-rest twist as deformation twist. Plane-dependent compensation can therefore yield large helper changes despite passing direct projected axial readouts. Matched160deg flex/abd helper excursions support prioritizing this route.
